scope: Faithful explicit module/ring consequences of credited CT38/39/40 inputs. statement: theorem polynomial_projector_naturality {M N : Type} [IntModule M] [IntModule N] (pi : M → M) (tau : N → N) (f : M → N) (fl : ∀ (n : Int) a, f (n • a) = n • f a) (fa : ∀ a b, f (a+b) = f a+f b) (fc : ∀ a, f (pi a) = tau (f a)) (u a b c d : Int) (x : M) : f (u • (a • pi (pi (pi x))+b • pi (pi x)+c • pi x+d • x)) = u • (a • tau (tau (tau (f x)))+b • tau (tau (f x))+c • tau (f x)+d • f x)
